name: minimal-agent
description: Umbrella monorepo: git submodules for minimal-agent-core, minimal-agent-plugins, minimal-agent-cli, and minimal-agent-web.

scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd minimal-agent-core && bun install --cwd minimal-agent-plugins && bun install --cwd minimal-agent-cli && bun install --cwd minimal-agent-web
scripts.test: bun run --cwd minimal-agent-core test && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins test && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-cli test && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-web test
scripts.check: bun run --cwd minimal-agent-core check && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins check && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-cli check && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-web check
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd minimal-agent-core typecheck && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins typecheck && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-cli typecheck && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-web typecheck
